Our advanced spam detection and call blocker automatically stops telemarketers, robocallers, and unknown phone numbers before they reach you, ensuring you only answer important calls. quotes.text:
Thanks for pointing this out!  My volume of spam robocalls and SMS has gone through the roof this year, and I knew there had to be some app that did like a collaborative blacklist for these numbers.  This TrueCaller appears to do the trick.

Play store link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.truecaller

There are quite a few Android apps out that crowdsource call blocklists. I have been using Truecaller[0] with good results thus far.

quotes.story_title: I was tricked on Facebook into downloading an obfuscated script

quotes.text:
Hey,

I was out with someone I met. So after we had a coffee etc we said lets exchange numbers.

I am doing a misscall to him and he had an app that literally spitted out my email address on his phone...

I feel very unsafe after that. 
I am using gmail and I understand the implications on my privacy using google as my provider but thats just too much...

Why would a random app be able to connect my mobile number and my email together, and how?

How do I take it off?

Any help is much appreciated.

(I've no idea what the app is called, he was using an android phone)
Update: I think this is the app https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.truecaller&hl=en_GB
